purpose: Close with one clear, truthful action tied to the verified product destination.
whenToUse: A verified CTA label and destination are available
whenNotToUse: The destination is unknown or inaccessible
The call to action implies an unsupported offer or urgency

layoutContract.focus: Keep one action dominant and remove competing feature copy.
layoutContract.safeArea: Keep CTA and destination inside the configured safe area.

motionContract.entrance: Resolve prior motion into a stable brand frame, then reveal the CTA.
motionContract.determinism: Use a finite entrance and hold; do not loop or pulse indefinitely.
motionContract.ending: Keep visible content through the final frame to avoid a blank tail.

transitionOptions.use: Use a brand shape carried from the prior scene.
Use when returning to the hero identity.

captionRules.copy: Use the exact CTA label; avoid adding urgency or an offer that is not in the input.
captionRules.placement: Keep captions separate from the CTA control and URL.

fallbacks.action: Use product name as the brand lockup.
Use the verified product homepage or stop before final render if no destination exists.

qaRules: Exactly one primary CTA is visible
CTA remains readable through the final frame
